text_blocks.snippet: The national animal of India is the Royal Bengal Tiger (Panthera tigris tigris).

list.snippet: Symbolism: It represents the country's grace, strength, agility, and immense power.
Adoption: The tiger was chosen and declared the national animal in November 1972 (and officially adopted under Project Tiger in April 1973).
Previous Holder: Before the tiger, the Asiatic lion served as India's national animal until 1972.
National Heritage Animal: India also designated the Indian elephant as its national heritage animal in 2010.
